reason: I eat 50-baht street food most days and only cook when I have time, and when I do, Mum's recipes on LINE cost nothing. Paying 99 baht every month, two plates of food, for something I'd open once or twice a week doesn't make sense on my allowance.
objection: I don't see it beating what I already have: Mum's recipes, plus a LINE voice message to her when I get stuck. 'Ask the chef' still means typing with greasy fingers, which is exactly what I hate.
would_change_my_mind: If the Sunday cook-ahead plan showed my week of food costing clearly less than eating out at 50-60 baht a plate, so the app pays for itself.
